entry.title: Vibe FX 1.0.0
entry.summary: First stable release. Same build as 0.9.1 (the fixed-wrapper rebuild — physical Q-Links move plugin parameters on the track **automation** screen), promoted to 1.0.0 after running well on-device. - Drive, chorus, FDN reverb and tape delay in one native MPC OS insert effect, touchscreen skin and Q-Links. - Built on the fixed mpc-vst-plugins wrapper (sd88me #486–489); ships `params.lock`.

entry.title: Vibe FX 0.9.0
entry.summary: A native **Akai MPC OS insert effect** — drive, chorus, reverb and tape delay in one slot, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links. VST2 for MPC OS (armv7). **Signal chain:** `IN → DRIVE → CHORUS → (dry) ─┬─ REVERB × send ─┐ └─ DELAY × send ─┴─ OUT` - **Drive** — tape-style saturation front end - **Chorus** — Juno-style stereo BBD chorus (rate / depth / mix) - **Reverb** — FDN hall (decay, damping, high-pass, pre-delay) on its own send - **Tape delay** — free or tempo-synced (dotted divisions), bipo
